titulo: Why the Rich Get Richer: One Chicken Explains It 🐔#shorts #moneylessons #personalfinance
descripcion:
God took everything away and gave everyone one chicken. Three groups made three different choices, and one chicken split them into the poor, the middle class and the rich. This is a 30-second lesson on how money grows when you invest instead of consume. Which group would you have been? Comment 1, 2 or 3. 👇
